newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed,inquiries seen on SMR20.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed,inquiries seen on SMR20.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended mixed, with the market not doing any known business despite inquiries from Middle East and China, traders said.
"It was quiet day, but we saw some inquiries for the SMR20 from Mid-East and Chinese clients," said a trader.
He said Mid-East buyers were interested in June shipment at between 259-260 cents ($1.03-$1.04) a kg. The Chinese were also looking for prompt shipment, but at between 257-258, said the trader.
At the close, June RSS1 buyer was officially quoted at 282 Malaysian/Singapore cents a kg, up half cent from Tuesday.
June SMR20 was officially quoted half cent down at 264 cents.
Traders priced the SMR 20 at 261, SMR CV at 330, SMR L at 308, SMR 10 at 262 and drum latex at 227.
The INRO five-day average was 213.19 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on May 27 from 212.59 on May 26. The daily indicator was 214.68 against 213.12.

A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU (or 20-ft container), and $1,700 per two-TEU containers (or 40-ft container). -- K. Baranee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5120 ringgit)
